subject: English Home Language

source.topic: This is what I wear: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'e' sound at the beginning of words; recognises letters introduced so far

show.line: Listen. e as in egg. e, e, egg. Your elbow starts with e too!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with e, as in egg?
Say the sound with me. e, as in egg!

rounds.story: Emma puts on her jersey. Her elbow pokes through a hole! What pokes through the hole?

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with e? e, e.
What is this? It starts with e.
Does it start with e? Put e words in the e group.

hints: Listen for e at the start. e, e, egg.
Open your mouth a little and say e.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with e.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Hat starts with h. Egg starts with e.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. e, e, egg. Egg starts with e!

parent_line: Can hear the e sound at the start of words.
